en: Y-Y-Y'gotta be kiddin' me!
Who's this Someya bastard anyways?

Well Kiyomi <font_kind=yakuza_italic>did</font_kind> say she used
t'live in Tokyo, didn't she?

She's even got that Tokyo accent.
Maybe she dated the guy or somethin'.
Y'think they used to be married!?

Dumbass! Y'implyin' Kiyo-chan
is divorced!? Ain't no way!
How would you know!?

It's freakin' obvious! The name Kiyomi's
s'posed t'represent purity and beauty!

Pure women get married too, man! Besides,
wouldn't her getting divorced make sense?

Why else would someone her age come all
the way back here jus' to open a bar!?

Yer wrong. I bet a pretty girl like Kiyo-chan
jus' couldn't handle all the Tokyo pollution.

Oh yeah. She's pretty good at lookin' after
kids, too. Ain't that right, Kiryu-aniki?
Huh? Uh, I suppose she is.
Y'think she has a kid of her own?
You asswipe!

A real woman can take care o'kids
even if she ain't got her own!

You buttheads wanna keep talkin' shit
or do I gotta bust ya!?
You know this is all speculation, right?
Don't blow it out of proportion.

A-Aniki... I know yer right,
but I jus' can't calm m'self down.

And if that guy's a yakuza,
it's even worse.
Y'guys! Help!
Ino? What's goin' on?

It's Kiyo-chan...
She just got nabbed!
These are...
...Masks?
They're shady is what they are.
Why d'ya even have these, boss?

I used to wear 'em if I wanted
to beat the crap outta someone.
Usually guys from the main family.
They never got wise, either.

Maybe, but there probly weren't too many
thugs runnin' around in ski masks.
I bet they had some guesses.

Here y'go.
This one's yers, Aniki.
Huh? No way.
I'm not big on hiding.
Whaddya mean?

The Yomei Alliance knows you've been
hangin' around with us, Kiryu-aniki.

If they see you there,
they'll ID us fer sure.

Aniki. We don't got time t'be
wafflin' around 'bout this.
Fine then.
Wh-Who're you!?

C'mon out! Get ready fer
a righteous ass whoopin'!

Aniki.
Looks like that Someya guy ain't here.
Guess we still gotta look in there, though.

This shit's intense.
What kinda room is this!?

It's too freakin' hot!
Sorry, I gotta get outta here.
Wait!
Ahhh, that's better!
The hell is this!?

That you, Nagumo!?
Whaddya think yer doin'!?

Yer wrong!
I totally ain't Nagumo...!

Yer dumb as rocks!
It's too late t'hide!
Awww hell!

Oh really?
Is that you, Kiryu-san?
Someya!

Looks like we can't write this
meeting off as coincidence.

And what's with that outfit?
Aren't you hot in that?
Kiyomi better be safe.
Where are you hiding her!?

I can't believe our fourth chairman would
stoop so low over one woman.
The rumors about you were right.
I asked you where the girl is.
Give me a straight answer.
I see now. You want to fight me?

Unfortunately for you,
I'm not interested.

Your little raid has me at a disadvantage.
I'm not dumb enough to fight you head on.

You know, I've made it this far
because I only fight on sure bets.
You're saying you're a coward, then.

Let's not jump to any conclusions.
I haven't lost this fight just yet.
You know what they say, don't you?
Live to fight another day!
Bastard!
Dammit. Get back here!
No more running!

Look what you've done. I only just took
a bath, and I'm covered in sweat again.
I'll have to take another one later.
I see you've yet to get any ink done.

In this day and age, tattoos are
nothing but a hindrance.

We no longer live in a world where
yakuza shake down civilians for cash.

Working an honest job is a far safer
alternative, really. Pays better, too.
That's what the leadership teaches now.
Tattoos aren't supposed to be threats.

They represent the ideals
of the life you've chosen to lead.

You think a few drops of ink
really carry that much weight?
Stop dreaming.
Excuse me?
The real world is a harsh mistress.

If a worker wants to please his boss,
he raises profits, wouldn't you agree?

So if tats are going to hurt your bottom line,
the modern yakuza is right to avoid them.

If profits have become more important than
the dream, then the yakuza are finished.

A clan only survives because there's a guy
with ideals worth following on his back.

If the weaker members don't see strength
at the top, they'll start drifting away.

Funny you say that. Money is what's kept new
recruits coming our way these past years.
At least, Sugai-san seems to think so.
But it's fine.
If you want Kiyomi, she's in there.

My men are probably enjoying
their time with her as we speak.
Keep the lies to yourself.
All I needed was her location.

Now let's get this over with
so I can get her out of here.
That won't be as easy as you think.
If I'm facing the legendary fourth chairman...

I'll need to show proper respect.
I won't hold anything back!
Everythin' okay here?
What's this?
That you, Kiryu-san?
Oh, and Hirose's imbecile's here, too.
Koshimizu!

We've been expectin' ya.
Come on in.
Kiryu-san?
Kiyo-chan! Are y'okay!?
What are you two doing here?
Can you explain this interference?
President Iwami.
Iwami?
We've come to take Kiyomi home.

We were told she was being held
here against her will.
Held? And who told ya that?

We were just extendin' our
hospitality to our guest's wife here.
Wh-What're y'talkin' about?

Ah, that was a lovely pre-dinner
workout. Thanks, Fourth Chairman.
Kiyomi's, well...
She's my ex-wife.
You used to be married?
Is this true, Kiyomi?

He's makin' it up!
He's gotta be!

It was a surprise findin' Someya-san's ex-wife
in this little town, but fate's funny like that.
So we invited her up.

It's clear this is a misunderstanding.
However, there must still be consequences.
Wouldn't you say, Koshimizu-san?
Yeah, absolutely.

Consider the Hirose Family cut off from the Yomei Alliance.
Yer patriarch's cuttin' off a finger, too.

Hold on a sec!
Hirose-san didn't do nothin'!
Shut yer mouth!

Someya-san here came all the way from
Tokyo t'swear an oath with us, as our guest.
Y'think a finger even makes up for this!?
That's enough, Koshimizu-kun.

This was meant to be a celebration.
You're scaring Kiyomi-san.
Let's bury the hatchet for today.
But Chairman...

Listen closely. When I say to forget it,
you forget it. Do I make myself clear?
Yes, I understand.

And you, Someya-san?
You don't mind, do you?

Of course not. I caused this
misunderstanding to begin with.

The chairman of Iwami Shipbuilding.
My name is Heizo Iwami.

Chairman Iwami leads the Iwami Group,
which in turn heads up Iwami Shipbuilding.
He also goes by another name.
Takeru Kurusu.
Chairman of the Yomei Alliance.

Takeru Kurusu is the name he uses
for all yakuza operations.

So the head of Iwami Shipbuilding
is also the chairman of the Yomei Alliance?

Nowadays it would be more accurate to say
the Iwami Group is a "front" for the Yomei.

This is my son, Tsuneo.
He acts as president of Iwami Shipbuilding.
It's a pleasure to meet you.
My name is K<symbol=em_dash_with_outline>
Kazuma Kiryu.

The Tojo Clan's fourth chairman, yes?
I'm quite familiar.

However, it seems this is
no place for us to speak.
Why don't we go elsewhere?
Fine by me.
Hey, those masks work out okay?
They didn't catch on?

Well, Captain Nagumo got too hot
n' ripped his off partway through.
We went through all that fer nothin'.

What happened t'you, Nagumo?
Y'gotta sack up.
I... I can't believe it...
What's his problem?
Forget it.

Here, lemme show you guys
the right way to use a mask.
Tagashira, get over here.
Oh, Kiryu-san!
Mama. Shouldn't you be at the bar?

I wanted to wait for you.
We never finished talking about Haruka-chan.
Maybe not, but...
How are you doing?

I'm okay now. Just a little shaken
after everything that happened.
The masks're good, yeah?

Hey, boss... They're kinda
in the middle of somethin'.
Uh, don't mind us.

Anyway, we were talking about
who Haruto-kun's dad might be.

Right. You said you have
an idea of who he is.
Huh? Do you really?
Kiryu-aniki. Kamurocho...
I wanna go with you.
I can't let Tatsukawa go.

That son of a bitch. He's gonna pay
fer what he did to Haruka-chan.

I won't be able to sleep until I
beat the shit out of him myself!
I'm goin', too.
Y'are, Cap? Why?

It's too painful for him to stay here.
Pretty obvious.
That's what a broken heart does, huh?
Um, I should probably get going then.

This works out fine. Might even be a nice
change of pace in Kamurocho with you two.
So this is Kamurocho!

That dumbass Tatsukawa. What was
he thinkin' coming to a city like this?

Yuta, it's yer first time in Tokyo, yeah?
Y'ain't even been outta Hiroshima before.
Try not to embarrass us now, y'hear!?

Don't let bein' a country bumpkin
make ya an easy mark.
Hey, you can't smoke on the street.

You can't just walk and smoke nowadays.
You need to go somewhere private.
Oh, you fer real with that?
Please try not to embarrass us, Cap.
Ya shitstick.

Well, do you want to go for a smoke
before we look for Tatsukawa?
There's a café near here called Alps.

Y'really wanna go to some
regular ol' coffee shop t'smoke?

We're in Kamurocho, ain't we?
Let's go someplace with booze! N' ladies!

What're you talking about, Cap?
We're not here to mess around, y'know.
Hey, it's him.

He's the guy who tossed
Yuta outta that club.
Hey! The yakiniku's great here, huh?

The smell is to die for. And isn't
the meat perfect in every way?

Sorry to interrupt your meal.
I'm the proprietor of Stardust.
The name's Joon-gi Han.

As I hear it, you graced my club
with your presence earlier today.

Only to have this imbecile
turn you away at the door!
Wh-What the hell're y'doin'!?

If you'd be interested, can I
make up for his discourtesy?
The hell is this place...?
Aniki. Are all host clubs like this?
Quite a vulgar place, isn't it?

But I must say, this stimulation is
exactly what Stardust was missing.
They even call it...
The Eden of Tokyo.
I'm not quite finished yet.
Yuta's done everything he can.

For every punch you threw,
he never turned his back on you.

If you want proof of his strength,
he's already given it.
Stop it.
I'll fight you.
You're after me, aren't you?
Very well. In that case...
Let us proceed to the main event.
You were very effective bait, friend.

By making the Dragon of Dojima kneel to me,
I'll bring the Jingweon into a new epoch.

We will finally forget our grudges of the
past and push forward into the modern era.

Maybe so.
But you'll have to defeat me first.
It seems age has clouded your vision.

A new dawn is fast approaching.
The time of Kazuma Kiryu is over.

My heart races at the thought of being
the one to bring closure to your legend.
I don't care what you say.

But... I won't let you forget
your promise, Joon-gi Han.

You mean about Tatsukawa?
Of course.

Unlike you spineless yakuza, I take
quite a bit of pride in my sportsmanship.

Once our fight is over, I will be
glad to tell you everything I know.
All I ask is...
...Don't hold anything back.
You don't need to worry about that.
Let's go!

Everyone here will bear witness.
The dragon of legend shall be put to rest!
Go, go, go!
I love you, Han-sama!
Show's over, Joon-gi Han.
Yuta!
Get your fucking hands off of him!

What's up with these rooms?
Feels like nobody's here...

Yer right about that. There ain't
even nameplates on the doors.
What about that one?

Go fer it, Yuta.
Take a little peek inside.
It's open.
Jus' go already.
What'd y'see?
What the...?
It's Tatsukawa.
Y-Yer kiddin'!
No way!
But... Why?

Hm? I don't recall having
any appointments today.
You are?

Who do you think?
You can't put the pieces together?

Ah, now I see.
I do know that voice.
The Dragon of Dojima.

I'm in need of some answers...
And I'll do what it takes to get them.
We need to talk.

[D-Dammit! How could we let
these fucking whelps humiliate us!?]
Kiryu-aniki. This is Ed?
Yeah. He's the one who killed Tatsukawa.
Ed. Just answer this.

What was Tatsukawa really like?
Why did you kill him?
How exactly did he betray you?
You don't know when to quit...
Answer me!
Bastards... I'll murder you all!
And what if I kill you first!? Huh!?
That's... M-Masuzoe!
Masuzoe?
K-Kiryu-aniki!
I gotta say...
This is a real pain in the ass.

The four o' you really made
a mess outta this one...
Boss!
Should you be showing yourself here?

I am the head of the Saio Triad.
You may call me Lo.

So you're the boss of
this organization?

Indeed. I've heard a great deal
about you from Masuzoe.

Every yakuza in the country acknowledges
the strength you possess, Kiryu-san.
You are the Dragon of Dojima, yes?

What could a man like yourself have wanted
out in Onomichi? I'm very much intrigued.
[Lower your guns.]
